title: Shattered SMP
description: This plugin adds all the things from Shattered SMP. It adds 5 special amethyst shards.
body:
Shattered SMP is a custom Paper plugin that adds a unique one-of-a-kind Mace weapon and 5 special Amethyst Shards to your server.
The One Mace
Only a single mace can ever exist on the server at once — it can't be crafted or duplicated if one already exists. It comes pre-enchanted with Density V, is unbreakable, and admins can give it via /givemace <player>.
The 5 Special Amethyst Shards
Each shard is unique — once crafted, it's locked and can't be crafted again. They're obtained by crafting a special recipe (3 Beacons on top, Blackstone + Amethyst Shard + Blackstone in the middle, Blackstone + Netherite Upgrade Template + Blackstone on the bottom), which opens a GUI for the player to pick which shard they want.

Shard of Repulsion — Hit any entity while holding it to launch them with extreme knockback (Knockback X force)
Shard of Attraction — Right-click to pull all nearby entities within 7 blocks toward you (30 second cooldown)
Shard of Devastation — Passively deals 1.5x damage; every 60 seconds charges a 2.5x hit that you activate by right-clicking
Shard of Blessing — Grants 3 randomly chosen beacon effects (Speed, Haste, Strength, etc.) while kept in your inventory
Shard of Vanishing — Right-click to go fully invisible for 7 minutes, hides your armor, fakes a disconnect message to other players, and removes you from the tab list (12 minute cooldown)
